result.statement: For conjugate 1<q<2, p=q/(q-1), a uniformly Lp-bounded source-disjoint core and a disjoint cap-one quadratic receiver bank W^T C W+beta^T W+gamma yield ||p_Q||_infinity <= K [2^(q-1)/(2-q)]^(1/q) Ccap(a_i)^((q-1)/q) for every nonzero physical receiver row a_i, where Ccap(a)=min(1/||a||_infinity,sqrt(2)/||a||_2). At p=3,q=3/2 this is <=2^(7/6)K||a_i||_2^(-1/3). The branch density is continuous and the constant is uniform over translations, distant fragmentation, unbounded supports and all moments.
